claims.quote: abnormal function of a presynaptic voltage-gated calcium channel, CACNA1A.
Migraine is a chronic episodic disorder that has been linked to abnormalities in serotonin signaling and abnormal function of a presynaptic voltage-gated calcium channel, CACNA1A.
